subject: general
question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 44?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A number is divisible by **44** if it is divisible by both **4** and **11**.

Check **Divisibility by 4**: Last two digits must be divisible by 4. Only **3344** (44 ÷ 4 = 11) satisfies this.

Check **Divisibility by 11** for 3344: (3 + 4) − (3 + 4) = 0. Since the difference is 0, it is divisible by 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 3344.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers 3379, 3344, 3550, 2967.

**Condition:** Number must be divisible by 44 (i.e., 4 × 11).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45af1643594905f7e38d19f3852777979abe2ea61348e71e7358f6677da8880c.png] 

⇒ Divisibility by 4: Last two digits of **3344** are **44**. 44 ÷ 4 = 11 (Divisible).

⇒ Divisibility by 11: Sum of odd place digits = 3 + 4 = 7; Sum of even place digits = 3 + 4 = 7.

⇒ Difference = 7 − 7 = 0. Since result is 0, it is divisible by 11.

⇒ Other options: 3379 (odd), 3550 (50 not div by 4), 2967 (odd) fail the test.

**∴ The correct answer is 3344.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 4

A number is divisible by 4 if its **last two digits** are divisible by 4 or if the last two digits are 00.

Divisibility Rule of 11

The **difference** between the sum of digits at odd places and the sum of digits at even places must be 0 or a multiple of 11.

Composite Divisibility

To check divisibility by a composite number **N**, check divisibility by its **co-prime factors** (e.g., for 12, check 3 and 4).</p
